title: Voice Lint and Voice Studio: readiness
summary: Voice Studio supports supervised local file review with saved decisions, reviewed source changes and seven-day browser sessions. @voice/writing-rules supplies 20 named AI anti-patterns, four six-rule profiles, EN/DE examples and counter-prompts; eight rules have transparent local surface checks. The native Research website area contains seven practice sources, nine studies, four strategy studies and eight library comparisons with methods, limits, official references and reusable JSON. It connects research to the pattern catalogue without treating anecdotes as model benchmarks. Public HTML guides describe current behavior, file trees and saved JSON; internal AGT and holistic implementation plans remain in repository docs. No authorship detector, measured model effectiveness, automatic holistic evaluator or public deployment is claimed. Studio retains its existing four local checks; the expanded catalogue is independently reusable by hosts.
